tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zhi ba'i bstod bskul bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po bya rog can la phyag 'tshal lo// hūṃ/ rab dkar zhi ba'i cha tsam gzung ba'ang sa gsum gyi| /dbang phyug chen po'i spyi bor rtag tu brten gyur pa// de phyir dag pa'i cha rdzogs khyod las gzhan 'di na// srid pa'i gdung skyob ci yang med mno skyabs zhus so// 'dod chen rnams kyi rgyu skar bdag po la// mtshan mo'i mgon po zhes bsngags 'di'i rtsis na// 'jig rten gsum po 'di na ci mchis pa'i// bstod ra thams cad khyod la gtong bar 'os// mtha' dag nyin mor byas snyam cher gyur pa// spyang ki'i mche ba'i zhud kyi zhum par bla// bdud bzhi'i sde dpung rmeg med bcom pas khyod// gang dang cir yang zhum khengs med pas mtshar// nyid kyis rigs gsum mngon sum bgyis pas na// thogs pa'i sgrib pa kun las grol ba'i phyir// thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad gzigs pas de// kun gyi ston par 'os nas phyag bgyis so// khyod kyi chos kyi 'khor lo phul byung ba// rigs gsum rgyud la 'khor bas nyon mongs dgra// rab zhi smin grol bder 'tsho'i bka' rtags thod// dpal mo'i dpal gyi thor cog ltar mtho'o// la lar zhi dang 'gar ni khro ba dang*// chags sogs ci dgar ston pa'i 'gyur med dbyings// sngags kyi rnam par 'khrul pa la sbyangs ba'i// sgyu ma byed pa'i rdzas dang mtshungs snyam bgyid// ji ltar sman dang dgon pa'i shing bzhin du// 'gro ba'i dgos pa kun tu khyod 'char tam// spang gyur 'jam pa'i dbyangs de sgrog pas su// phyin chad dbul 'phongs ming du zad 'gyur ro// bu chung nyes par zhugs la ma khros nas// brdeg tshog mi snyan tshig rtsub smra ba yang*// byams pa'i rnam 'gyur nyid du bas pa bzhin// nyid sku'i khro tshul 'di yang de bzhin yin// gang gi phyag bzhi phyag cha'i rigs pas kyang*// phan pa'i gnyen du gsol bar byas pa 'di// sngon tshe smon 'jug thugs sbyangs rnam smin phyir// rgyu 'bras rten 'byung sgrub byed chen por song*// de kha dge ba spyod pa'i 'dren byed dpyid// sdig zhugs dngangs ba srog gi gshed mngon sum// glang chen smyon pa'i snar bcangs ral gri rno// phas rgol mu stegs las ngan rgyud gcod lags// sman gyi bu mo dpag bsam ljon pa'i rgyal| /lcags kyu mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i dpal nus ni// khyod gsung gsang sngags rigs pa gzungs kyi sde// ting 'dzin phyag rgya'i khung las mngon du rgyu// gnod par sbyar yang khyod mthu'i skyo thang gi

/bde bar drangs pas thal ba'i dbyangs song bzhin// tshar gcod rjes gzung gzhi gcig la 'du bas// dkar nag las kun mnyam pa nyid du sbyangs| /khyod dpal sangs rgyas nyid kyi bskal pa ni// gaṅga'i klung ni ji snyed brjod mi zad// de phyir bdag gi brjod par mi spobs bzhin// smras 'di shis brjod sngon btang zhu 'dod ched| /snyigs ma'i dbang gis mi shes shugs rgyas nas// rgyal ba dang ni mgon po chen po khyod// ston dang de yi gnyer kha 'dzin pa'i khyad// 'byed las nongs pa ci dgos bshags lags so// 'on kyang khyod ni ris med cir gzung ba// de kha'i don grub nyid kyi nyams nyes pa// ma yin bya ba'i yul la yod pa yi// mdzad pa'i mchog gi snyam dga' tshangs pa thob// des na rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che// dus kyi 'byung khungs rnams na'ang rnyed dka' ba// gang yod mngon sum phyung nas bdag cig gi /longs spyod chen po'i phyir du sbyin par gsol// 'ga' la 'chad nyan bgyid rlom de dag na'ang*// gser la ra bzhin rtog ges bslad pas su// 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub dkas skyon sel kyang*// mdzod cig gzhan gyis nus pa'i yul min no// gzhan lta zlog zer lus ngag yid ngal ring*// rang lugs 'ja' tshon gar song khung med pa'i// kha 'chal char mun 'thibs pa 'di sol la// thub bstan nyi 'od rgyas par mdzad du gsol// rgyud sde'i thang la hol rgyugs byas pas su// smin dang bskyed rdzogs gnad kyi chus 'phongs nas// tha snyad smig rgyu'i rjes 'brang ngal 'di rnams// dbugs 'byin mdzad par rtag tu gsol ba 'debs// tshe gcig sangs rgyas sa la 'gro rings nas// snying po'i gseb lam 'di ru zhugs gyur kyang*// bag ldan sa mkhan med pas thoms rnams la// dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhu zhes smre sngags bton// bde ba'i go skabs yangs pa 'di nas su// bde 'gro dor nas ngan 'gro'i ca 'phrang du// nan gyis 'tshang kun zhi bslabs mi nyan pas// bka' non phob ces khyod la 'bod pa rgyab// dpal yon kun gyi ke la sha'i ri bo// rab dkar bdud rtsi phung po khyod mdun du// 'khor ba'i tshad gdungs 'thibs pos bdag cag mnar// gzhan don dus las yol 'dra sbran lags so// re zhig rang las lhu long de nas so// dgongs na gzhan don bsags pa'i dga' char sprin// rgyal pos phug spyod mnyam nor sbas pa'i mdzod// phan med yal ba de bzhin mi 'gyur grang*// gzhan du rang la rag lus nyid gyur na// dbang phyug rgyang phan 'dod pa tshang mar song*// nad par sman pa zhing la so nam sogs// 'bad pa'ang ngal ba kho nar ma zad dam// gangs kyang tsha ba'i drod dang ma phrad ring*// bsil ba'i chu klung 'bebs pa mi spro la// rtsol bas chu gter bgrod pas nor thob pa// mngon gyur rgyu mtshan gsol nas khyod thugs bskul// bdag mthu zhan pas khyod la res pa ste// stobs mnyam re ltos zhu dgos ma mchis pa// dpa' bo phan tshun 'dra ba'ang gzigs mdzod ces// ldab ldib 'chi ka'i ngag 'dras spos thol zhus// phug pa zhwa ltar gyon nas khyod sgrubs shing*// dam rdzas rten du btsugs nas khyod bos la// dka' dgu dang du blang nas khyod mchod kyang*// mchog ster mi mdzad mgon po khyod re zhan// bdag la chos kyi bar chad thams cad bdo'o// sdug bsngal tshogs kyang cung zad gra ma chag

/na rga 'chi ba'i 'jig pa'ang drung gnyer bas// mchi ma lhug par shor gyi rogs la byon// gnod pa byed pa 'di kun tsha raṃ raṃ// grogs yongs bsil skyob sprin bzhin yal le le// ci drag la gtor smre dngangs di ri ri// khyod snyan bsun rung mi bya'i thabs ma byung*// tshul gnas thos bsam bsgom la 'bad pa yi// lung rtogs bstan pa 'dzin la gegs 'di 'dra// tshar gcod mi mdzad btang snyoms khyod bzhugs na// bstan bsrung gnyan po ming du zad par 'gyur// 'jig rten 'di na dbul zhing 'phongs pa mod// phal cher chos las nor la rin thang che// 'di 'dra'i dus 'di zhi bar mi mdzad na// rgyal ba'i spyan sngar dam bcas g.yel ba yin// thugs rje dbang phyug de yang thos pa'i lam// gzhan don mthar phyin brnyes pa'ang kha skad ka /nus pa de yang 'gar ste gzhan rdugs snyam// rnal 'byor yi chad skye yi snying ma ring*// bdag ni chos bzhin spyod 'dod ma lags pa// bsam pa gnyis pa ma mchis khyed rang dpang*// de phyir zhu tshig bden pa'i gtam gsan nas// 'khor dang bcas pa mthu rtsal la'ur phyung*// ces mgon po phyag bzhi pa zhi ba'i las la bskul ba padma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /
